name: CYP-TRACE
description: Code, model assets and redistributable data supporting CYP-TRACE: evidence-aware evaluation of cytochrome P450 function prediction. This archive preserves GitHub tag submission-20260922, commit 2cc6909b0697e144baa61308d86fe2f077225443. It contains the coverage/ranking evaluator, fixed-human substrate-ranking software, a frozen human kNN model, original public human-label source files, normalized labels, figure- and query-level source data, supplementary tables, analysis code, data dictionaries and executable reproduction checks. The 19-check acceptance suite covers source normalization, file integrity, saved-prediction metrics, open-evidence reconstruction, human model reconstruction and inference, and development-only logistic selection followed by external evaluation. The complete-core source entry point was separately executed against the 27 original P450Rdb and UniProt–Rhea files, reproducing 600 sequences, 1,341 reactions and 2,304 relationships. Input manifests, environments and 66 portable computation launchers specify the remaining upstream analyses. General-model refitting and original nested kNN selection were not rerun during package acceptance. The bundled open UniProt–Rhea component contains 375 sequences, 639 reactions and 1,232 relationships. Human analyses include 14,955 development labels and 3,035 primary external labels across six evaluated isoforms.
